label: Pose
note: Dance isolations, S1–S9 ensemble formations, and clean anatomical postures.

options.label: 💃 Gravure S-Curve Figure-Eight Hip Sway & Waist Glide
options.rule: stands in a sculpted S-curve facing the lens and rolls the hips in a slow, fluid figure-eight loop from left to right while gliding both palms downward along the ribs and waist with clean natural soft-tissue recoil
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 💃 K-Pop Idol Crisp Chest Pop → Vertical Body Wave → Hair Flip
options.rule: hits two crisp rhythmic chest pops on the beat, rolls a fluid vertical body wave from shoulders through ribcage to hips, and sweeps one hand up to flip the hair with a sharp idol wink
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.

options.label: 💃 Rear-Facing Deep Lumbar Arch, Glute Shimmy & Look-Back Smirk
options.rule: stands three-quarter rear to the camera with hands braced on upper thighs, deeply arches the lumbar spine to push the rounded glutes outward in a rhythmic left-right hip bounce, and glances back over one shoulder
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 💃 Floor Cat-Stretch Arch → Kneeling Upright Hair Sweep
options.rule: starts on hands and knees in a deep hollow-back cat stretch, then rises smoothly onto the knees to arch the chest forward while sweeping both hands up behind the head to lift the hair
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.

options.label: 💃 Graceful 360° Pirouette Spin into Hand-on-Hip Model Pose
options.rule: pivots smoothly on the ball of the foot through one continuous, unhurried 360-degree clockwise spin with hair flaring outward, settling into a front-facing S-curve pose with one hand on the hip
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 💃 Slow Collarbone, Neck & Chest Fingertip Trace
options.rule: slowly traces fingertips along the jawline, down the side of the neck, across the collarbone, and in a lingering circular glide over the upper chest while swaying the hips
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.

options.label: 💃 Two-Hand Waist Cinch & Pendulum Hip Tick-Tock
options.rule: wraps both hands firmly around the narrowest part of the waist and rocks the pelvis side-to-side like a rhythmic pendulum on every beat with natural soft-tissue sway
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 💃 Wall Lean Back-Arch & Slow Heel Slide Up the Wall
options.rule: leans shoulder blades against the wall with the lower back arched forward, sliding one heel slowly up the wall while trailing the opposite hand down the outer thigh
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 💃 Chair Reverse-Straddle — Forearms on Backrest & Slow Hip Grind
options.rule: straddles a chair facing the backrest, crosses both forearms on top of the backrest to prop the chin forward toward the camera, and rolls the hips in a slow circular grind on the seat
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 💃 Mirror Glass Palm Press & Side-Profile Body Undulation
options.rule: presses one open palm flat against the mirror glass at shoulder height and executes a slow side-profile body wave from chest to hips while locking eyes with the reflection
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 💃 Prone on Bed — Propped on Elbows with Crossed Ankles Swaying Behind
options.rule: lies prone on the stomach propped up on both elbows with chin resting in cupped palms, lazily crossing and swaying both raised calves and bare feet in the air behind
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 💃 Club VIP Podium — Wrists Crossed Overhead & Deep Bass Hip Drop
options.rule: raises both arms overhead with wrists loosely crossed, rolling the ribcage and dropping into a deep knee-bend hip bounce on the bass drop
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–10 s (141–241f) — Clean pose or groove hold.

options.label: 🎭 Ensemble (S1–S9): V-Formation Idol / Hero Squad Lineup (Center Lead + Flanking Wings)
options.rule: stage all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) in a sharp, depth-staggered V-formation facing the camera: <Subject 1> stands front-and-center in the foreground hero spot while <Subject 2> through <Subject N> flank symmetrically to the left and right in staggered depth tiers so every face and full outfit is unobstructed
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.

options.label: 🎭 Ensemble (S1–S9): VIP Velvet Sofa & Floor Lounge (Center Seated + Flanking Reclined)
options.rule: stage all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) across a wide luxury sofa and plush foreground rug: <Subject 1> sits centered on the cushions while flanking subjects recline on the armrests, lean over the backrest behind, and sit between knees on the floor in front in a cohesive multi-tier tableau
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.

options.label: 🎭 Ensemble (S1–S9): King-Bed Harem Surround (Center Subject + Flanking Partners)
options.rule: stage all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) across a sprawling king bed: the centerpiece subject reclines at the center while the surrounding partners kneel and drape closely along the left side, right side, pillows, and lower thighs with synchronized hands and kisses trailing across the body
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.

options.label: 🎭 Ensemble (S1–S9): 360° Back-to-Back Combat Defensive Ring (Weapons Drawn Outward)
options.rule: stage all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) standing shoulder-to-shoulder and back-to-back in a tight defensive circle at the center of the arena with weapons/fists raised outward toward the surrounding perimeter
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.

options.label: 🎭 Ensemble (S1–S9): Reservoir-Dogs / Avengers Slow-Motion Walk Abreast Toward Camera
options.rule: stage all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) walking forward abreast in a wide horizontal line straight toward the retreating camera in synchronized slow-motion stride with coats and hair billowing

options.label: 🎭 Ensemble (S1–S9): Long Banquet / Boardroom Table Panorama (Center Boss + Flanking Seats)
options.rule: stage all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) along the far side and ends of a long banquet or boardroom table facing the camera, with <Subject 1> commanding the center seat while the remaining subjects lean in, toast glasses, or converse on either side

options.label: 🎭 Ensemble (S1–S9): Synchronized K-Pop / Dance Group Choreography Formation
options.rule: stage all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) in a staggered diamond dance formation executing frame-accurate synchronized hip sways, chest pops, and arm angles to the beat
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.

options.label: 🎭 Ensemble (S1–S9): Poolside / Yacht Sunpad Group Pose (Foreground Edge + Daybed Tiers)
options.rule: stage all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) across two depth tiers: foreground subjects seated on the pool/yacht edge dangling bare legs in the water while midground subjects recline propped on elbows across the wide sunpad behind them
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 10–14 s (241–345f) — Multi-move choreography / ensemble blocking.
